rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure is straightforward property damage to covered real property.
claim_summary: Jordan Lee's back porch overhang lost four shingles due to weekend wind; estimated repair cost is $400. No water intrusion or other damage reported. Claim is below the $2,500 deductible and will require adjuster confirmation before any payment can be authorized.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off by wind, no water intrusion
